text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Sakura Bakushin O and I attend the Arima Kinen as spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Convinced that the Arima Kinen is the race most appropriate for a class representative such as herself, Sakura Bakushin O buzzes with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starring in the Arima Kinen may as well be next to impossible considering her capabilities… but I try to think of how to utilize this motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I believe her speed has higher potential and that Sakura Bakushin O will try to live up to those expectations.
